text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Negeri Sarawak (Pemeluasan
dan Ubah Suaian Akta Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi 1951) 2009.
Pemeluasan Akta dan perundangan subsidiari ke Negeri Sarawak

2. (1) Akta Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi 1951 (Akta 3711|, yang disebut "Akta
yang diperluas" dalam Perintah ini, adalah diperluas ke Negeri Sarawak.

P.U. (A) 425.                                     3822

(2) Peraturan-peraturan Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi 2004 (P.U. (A) 306/2004],
yang di buat di bawah Akta yang diperluas, yang disebut "perundangan subsidiari
yang diperluas" dalam Perintah ini, adalah diperluas ke Negeri Sarawak.

Ubah suaian Akta dan perundangan subsidiari yang diperluas

3. (1) Akta yang diperluas adalah diubah suai sebagaimana yang dinyatakan
dalam Jadual.

(2) Tertakluk kepada ubah suaian khas yang dibuat di bawah subperenggan (1),
perundangan subsidiari yang diperluas hendaklah dibaca bersama-sama dengan
perubahan yang bersamaan tentang nama atau nama jawatan sebagaimana
yang perlu untuk menyelaraskan perundangan subsidiari itu dengan Akta yang
diperluas sebagaimana yang diubahsuaikan oleh Perintah ini.

MALAYSIA ACT 1963

STATE OF SARAWAK (EXTENSION AND MODIFICATION OF
THE REGISTRATION OF PHARMACISTS AcT 1951) ORDER 2009

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 74 of the Malaysia Act 1963
[Act 26], the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

3823                                     P.U. (A) 425.

Citation

1. (1) This order may be cited as the State of Sarawak (Extension and
Modification of the Registration of Pharmacists Act 1951) Order 2009.

Extension of the Act and subsidiary legislation to the State of Sarawak

2. (1) The Registration of Pharmacists Act 1951 [Act 37/], which is referred
to as the "extended Act" in this Order, is extended to the State of Sarawak.

(2) The Registration of Pharmacists Regulations 2004 |P.U. (A) 306/2004],
which is referred to as the "extended subsidiary legislation" in this Order,
made under the extended Act is extended to the State of Sarawak.

Modification of the extended Act and subsidiary legislation

3. (1) The extended Act is modified in the manner as set out in the
Schedule.

(2) Subject to the specific modifications made under subparagraph (1), the
extended subsidiary legislation shall be read with such corresponding alterations
as to names or names of titles as may be necessary to bring that subsidiary
legislation into accord with the extended Act as modified by this Order.

SCHEDULE

|Subparagraph 3(1)]

Provision of the                                    Modification
Registration of Pharmacists
Act 1951
Subsection 1(2)                      Substitute for the words "only to the States of

Peninsular Malaysia" the words "to the States of
Peninsular Malaysia and the State of Sarawak".

Made 18 August 2009
[KKM.PUU(PU?)/PAF/1; PN(PU?)112/IV]

By Command,

TAN Sri Moup. Sidek BIN Haji HASSAN
Secretary to the Cabinet

[To be laid before the Dewan Rakyat and Dewan Negara pursuant to
